question: What is the exact JSON command format the stdin adapter must accept (key names, e.g. cmd/action, input, options), and the exact stdout text format for each command? Please list all supported commands and their output shapes.
answer: Alignment time. The public interface is fixed — exactly three operations, nothing else, and no alias like 'cmd': parse_report(operation, report, xml, as_readable_stream), serialize_fragment(operation, value), serialize_document(operation, value). Input: the execution adapter reads a single JSON object from stdin and routes on the "operation" field. parse_report carries "report", "xml", and optional "as_readable_stream"; serialize_fragment and serialize_document carry "value" (a kind/value descriptor). The adapter is a dispatcher only — it must contain zero business logic; every parsing and serialization decision is delegated to the core domain. Output: raw stdout, nothing else. The exact text shape per command is pinned byte-for-byte by the expected_output fields of the public test cases — key=value lines such as "type=object", "keys=A|B|C", "type=null", and the serialized XML fragments ending in a newline. I am not going to enumerate every feature's output shape from memory. Public test cases exist, one file per feature — ask me for a specific feature by name and I will give you the full test case JSON. To maintain compatibility with the harness, your entry point signatures must be strictly set to the three signatures above; the internal implementation is your problem.
